chat: Isabella Rodriguez
Hey Klaus, I noticed you're enjoying your meal. Have you ever tried writing poetry before?
Klaus Mueller
Hey Isabella, actually, I have dabbled in poetry a bit. It's something I find quite enjoyable and cathartic.
Isabella Rodriguez
That's wonderful Klaus. You know, I'm hosting a poetry party at Hobbs Cafe later today. It would be lovely if you could join us and maybe share some of your poetry.
Klaus Mueller
That sounds amazing, Isabella! I would love to join your poetry party and share some of my work.
Isabella Rodriguez
Great! Just a heads up, everyone attending the poetry party needs to bring a Shakespearian sonnet. Looking forward to hearing your work, Klaus!
Klaus Mueller
Thank you for the invite, Isabella. I'll make sure to bring a Shakespearian sonnet to the poetry party.
Isabella Rodriguez
I'll see you at the poetry party at 5 pm. Looking forward to hearing your Shakespearian sonnet!
Klaus Mueller
Thank you, Isabella. I'm excited to share my poetry at the party.
Isabella Rodriguez
I hope you have a wonderful day until the poetry party later!
Klaus Mueller
Thank you, Isabella. I'm looking forward to the poetry party later today. Do you need any help setting up for the event?
Isabella Rodriguez
Thank you for offering to help, Klaus! I could definitely use an extra hand with setting up for the poetry party.
Klaus Mueller
I'd be happy to help out, Isabella. Just let me know what you need assistance with.
Isabella Rodriguez
Great! Let's head over to the event space and start setting up for the poetry party. Your help will be much appreciated!
Klaus Mueller
I'm glad I can help out, Isabella. Let's make this poetry party memorable!
Isabella Rodriguez
Thank you, Klaus! Let's start by setting up the stage for the poetry readings.
Klaus Mueller
Is there a specific theme or dress code for the poetry party?
